snippet.title: Star Wars: Hunters – Empire Resurgent – Season 2 Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Play Star Wars: Hunters Season 2 free on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6058ldqOp 
 
Prepare for an epic new season of Star Wars: Hunters, 'Empire Resurgent’! Imposing Imperial security droid K-A0S storms into the Arena, ready to unleash her powerful tank-class abilities. Season 2 also introduces a thrilling new battlefield inspired by Darth Vader’s iconic castle, plus an all-new Arena Pass with cosmetics, stickers and more to be unlocked. 
 
#StarWarsHunters #NintendoSwitch
